description:
SpaceFox is a free, open-source space-themed watch face with a large 24-hour clock, four configurable Garmin activity fields, and the next available rocket launch with rocket artwork and a launch-site map. No ads, payments, subscriptions or SpaceFox account.

The countdown shows T- before a known launch time and T+ afterwards, with accumulating hours and active-screen seconds. The selected launch remains visible for at least 15 minutes after its scheduled time, or through a reviewed sourced ascent end. Reaching zero is not confirmation of liftoff. Rescheduled and stale information have separate indicators.

Choose steps, Body Battery, heart rate, stress, calories or watch battery for the four fields. Unavailable readings remain unavailable. English is the default; English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Auto are available. Configure the clock, countdown and individual field colors in settings.

Always-On uses a larger centered clock, weekday/date, countdown and battery with the same configured clock/countdown colors. It updates on permitted minute snapshots, with a fine pixel-rest pattern to protect the AMOLED display. The full map and animation are reserved for the active screen.

The feed URL is already set to https://jekamas.github.io/SpaceFox. An internet-connected paired phone through Garmin Connect is needed for background schedule and image updates. Initial loading may take several background events. The watch calculates time and countdown locally, retains accepted data during temporary failures, and can use its last valid cache offline. No always-on computer is required.

VERSION 0.1.6 SUPPORTS
Forerunner 165 and 165 Music; Forerunner 965; Forerunner 170 and 170 Music; Forerunner 570 42mm; Forerunner 70; Venu 3S; Venu 4 41mm; vivoactive 6.

This is a test release. The signed package and native simulator behavior were independently checked; FR165 Music and FR965 layouts were observed. Physical phone/watch delivery, settings and battery life still need confirmation. A Store version label or queued installation does not identify the code currently running on a watch.

Health values are used on the watch and are not uploaded to the launch publisher. Map points show launch sites, not your GPS position. Rocket artwork may use a reviewed representative when an exact variant is unavailable.

Source, setup, privacy and notices: https://github.com/JekaMas/SpaceFox
Support: https://github.com/JekaMas/SpaceFox/issues
Launch data: The Space Devs / Launch Library 2. Independent project; not endorsed by Garmin or launch operators.
whatsNew: 0.1.6 enlarges the Always-On clock, weekday/date, T-/T+ countdown and battery, keeping selected colors. The battery icon and circular field placement are clearer. Adds Forerunner 965 with a proportionally scaled layout. New code gets a fresh background attempt after an earlier version error, while retaining accepted launch data and matching artwork. Background prefetch and retries remain platform-bounded; redraws do not fetch data. Fixed duplicate LOW draws and clipped Russian error details. Native EN/RU layout, prior-version recovery and pixel-rest checks passed; all 21 packaged program signatures were verified. Real phone/watch confirmation remains pending.
